articles.title: Binance opens crypto trading to AI agents with user-set controls
articles.snippet: Binance’s Agent OS lets AI agents access market data, execute trades and make payments while giving users control over permissions and account access.

articles.title: Washington Goes All-In on Crypto: Trump Pushes Clarity, SEC Rules, and CFTC Warnings
articles.snippet: Trump urged executives to pass a "fair version" of the Clarity Act, the CFTC warned it would write its own rules if the bill stalls, and the SEC abruptly advanced its first crypto fundraising framework.

articles.title: Tensions Flare as CME, Kalshi Execs Clash Over Prediction Markets in DC
articles.snippet: CME Group Chairman Terry Duffy and Kalshi co-founder Luana Lopes Lara traded barbs during a CFTC meeting over prediction markets, manipulation, and regulatory standards.
